integrity: The comparison and inversion variables are defined precisely. Infinite assertions are supported by analytic proof; exact finite enumeration is supplementary only. Not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to stable first-element-pivot Quicksort on uniform random permutations. Decorrelating rate is an upper bound rather than a sharp rate. Finite independence is false. Historical implicit coverage remains possible, with a related 2012 preprint inaccessible in full. He–Peng–Xu (2018) full text could not be inspected.
title: Quantitative asymptotic independence of Quicksort cost and inversion fluctuations
